title: 6 Seol In-ah K-dramas to revisit after "Love in Disguise" - Hashtag Legend Hong Kong
text:
6 Seol In-ah K-dramas to revisit after ‘Love in Disguise’ | #legend Culture Watches & Jewellery Fashion Lifestyle Beauty #legend100 #legend signature Culture Film & Series Music Art & Design Watches & Jewellery Fashion Lifestyle Dining Travel & Stays Tech & Gadgets Motors Wellness Beauty #legend100 #legend signature Hong Kong Subscribe culture entertainment film & series 6 Seol In-ah K-dramas to revisit after "Love in Disguise"
 By Tom Kao November 18, 2026 Not ready to say goodbye to Seol In-ah and Yim Si-wan’s on-screen chemistry? With "Love in Disguise" heading into its finale next week, their unlikely romance is almost coming to an end. Seol plays Kang Jae-hee, a former special forces soldier turned detective who disguises herself as a man to investigate chaebol heir Yoon Yi-jun (Yim Si-wan), a murder suspect who unknowingly hires her as his personal secretary. Between keeping her identity secret, dealing with her demanding boss and catching unexpected feelings, Jae-hee certainly has her hands full. Here are six more Seol In-ah K-dramas worth revisiting 
 Business Proposal (2022)
 If you enjoyed the secret identities and workplace romance in Love in Disguise , Business Proposal is an obvious next watch. Seol plays Jin Young-seo, a wealthy heiress who convinces her best friend Shin Ha-ri (Kim Se-jeong) to go on a blind date in her place. The plan quickly backfires when Ha-ri discovers that her date is actually her boss, Kang Tae-moo (Ahn Hyo-seop). Meanwhile, Young-seo has her own love story with Tae-moo's secretary, Cha Sung-hoon (Kim Min-kyu), and their chemistry is just as fun to watch as the main couple's.
 Twinkling Watermelon (2023)
 For something a little more nostalgic, Twinkling Watermelon brings together time travel, music and young love. The story follows Eun-gyeol (Ryeoun), a teenage guitarist who unexpectedly travels back to 1995, where he meets his father, Yi-chan (Choi Hyun-wook), as a high school student. Seol takes on two connected roles, cellist Choi Se-kyung and her daughter On Eun-yoo, who also travels back in time hoping to change her family's future. Between the complicated timelines, teenage friendships and budding romances, there's plenty to enjoy, especially seeing Seol switch between two very different personalities.
 Oh My Ghost Clients (2025)
 If you're looking for something with a supernatural twist, Oh My Ghost Clients is worth adding to your watchlist. Jung Kyung-ho stars as No Moo-jin, a struggling labour attorney who nearly dies in an accident and makes a mysterious deal that leaves him able to see ghosts. Seol plays his quick-thinking sister-in-law Na Hee-joo, who teams up with him and YouTuber Go Gyeon-woo (Cha Hak-yeon) to investigate workplace injustices involving deceased workers. It's an unusual mix of comedy, mystery and surprisingly touching stories, with Seol bringing plenty of energy to the trio.
 Oasis (2023)
 In the mood for something more emotional? Oasis takes us back to South Korea in the 1980s and 1990s, where friendship, first love and ambition don't always go hand in hand. Seol plays Oh Jung-shin, a confident young woman who finds herself caught between childhood friends Lee Doo-hak (Jang Dong-yoon) and Choi Cheol-woong (Choo Young-woo), who both fall for her. But when a tragic incident tears their lives apart, Jung-shin must also fight to protect her family's cinema business. It's a more serious role that shows a different side of Seol.
 Beautiful Love, Wonderful Life (2019-2020)
 For a longer, more heartfelt watch, Beautiful Love, Wonderful Life might be just what you're looking for. Seol plays Kim Cheong-ah, a young woman still struggling with guilt and trauma following a tragic incident during her school years. While trying to pass the civil service examination, she crosses paths with Goo Jun-hwi (Kim Jae-young), a man who has little interest in love or marriage. As their relationship gradually develops, a painful secret connecting their families threatens to complicate everything. It's a slower romance, but one that gives Seol plenty of emotional moments to work with.
 Sunny Again Tomorrow (2018)
 Curious to see where Seol's journey as a leading actress began? Sunny Again Tomorrow takes us back to her first starring role as Kang Ha-nee, a determined high school graduate who's struggling to find steady work. After losing her job at a home-shopping company, she decides to start her own fashion business despite having little experience. Along the way, she clashes with merchandising director Lee Han-kyul (Jin Ju-hyung), while romantic misunderstandings and unexpected family secrets complicate her plans. It's a good reminder that Seol was playing strong-willed, ambitious characters long before Love in Disguise .
